title: Co-op sound, second try: the listener and loudness follow the players (DPC 0.9.172-dev6)
intro: Two controllers, both awake. A full party, open ground, no enemies, playing the Arisen, co-op off. Sound on (headphones help). About 2 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

probes.lway: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local L = D and D.R.lis; if not L then return 'none' end; return L.found or (L.failed and 'failed') or (L.active and ('trying ' .. tostring(L.ways[L.way_i]))) or 'idle'
probes.lerr: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.lis.err or -1
probes.lcam: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.lis.from_cam or -1
probes.camd: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.lis.d or -1
probes.lact: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.lis.active == true
probes.lerrs: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.lis.errs or 0
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or 'off')
probes.kb: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.cp.kb == true
probes.tried: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and table.concat(D.R.lis.tried or {}, '; ') or ''

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until co-op starts (player 1 the Arisen, player 2 the main pawn). 20 seconds.

expect.label: two controllers (player 1 not on the keyboard)

steps.text: Walk the Arisen and the pawn apart (20-30 m) so the camera pulls back, then stand still for a few seconds while DPC finds how to move the listener. 25 seconds.

expect.label: listener move active with the camera pulled back
a way to move the listener was found

steps.text: Stay apart and fight the air: LISTEN to both characters' footsteps AND swings, also when one walks away from the camera. 20 seconds.

expect.label: listener moved away from the camera (m)

steps.text: Switched OFF (the game's own sound): the cut-off and the quiet far swings should come back. Keep fighting the air. 15 seconds.
Switched back ON. Walk back together: the camera comes in. 15 seconds.
PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op.
Done. Tell Claude: both characters audible apart, swings included? Did switching it off bring the cut-off back?
